comparison: Both evaluate claims C1-C5 about formin expression and INF2 evolutionary conservation. Both find these background claims SUPPORTED by expression data and phylogenetic analysis. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C12-C16 about INF2 knockdown effects on invasion and LCK localization in HTR-8/SVneo cells. Both find these in vitro findings SUPPORTED by qPCR, invasion assays, and immunofluorescence data. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C17-C18 about F-actin and mitochondrial effects. OpenEval finds these SUPPORTED, but peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN and explicitly request investigation of INF2's role in mitochondrial fission and cytoskeletal effects. Significant disagreement on sufficiency of evidence.
Both evaluate claims C19-C23 about Inf2 temporal and spatial expression in mouse placenta. Both find these SUPPORTED by qPCR, immunohistochemistry, and co-localization studies. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C50-C55 about distinguishing INF2's invasion role from mitochondrial fission. OpenEval finds these SUPPORTED, but peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN and explicitly request investigation of actin, microtubule, and mitochondrial fission effects. Disagreement on mechanistic interpretation.

Both evaluate claims C6-C11 (and C49) about INF2 functions. OpenEval finds background claims SUPPORTED by literature. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting that authors account for other INF2 functions including mitochondrial fission and cytoskeletal effects. Disagreement on completeness of functional characterization.
Both evaluate claims C45-C47, C78-C79 about trophoblast biology and PE pathophysiology background. Both find these SUPPORTED by established literature. Complete agreement.
Both evaluate claims C39-C40, C73 about vessel density and labyrinth depth. Both find these SUPPORTED by histomorphometry with appropriate statistics. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C41-C43, C101-C102, C104 about angiogenic factor regulation in vitro. OpenEval finds these SUPPORTED, but peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN and request use of primary human trophoblasts and protein-level analyses. Disagreement on strength of cell line evidence.

Both evaluate claims C28-C29 about serum angiogenic factors. OpenEval finds these SUPPORTED as important negative results. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting discrepancy with in vitro data and requesting protein-level validation. Disagreement on interpretation of negative in vivo findings.
Both evaluate claims C98-C100 about umbilical Doppler parameters (PSV, S/D ratio, RI). Both find these negative findings SUPPORTED as complementary to positive Doppler results. Complete agreement.
Both evaluate claims C36, C94-C97 about nutrient transporters and inflammatory markers. Both find these negative findings SUPPORTED. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C30-C32 about gestation length and fetal weights. OpenEval finds these SUPPORTED, but peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning whether E18.5 vs P0 discrepancy reflects mild phenotype rather than severe IUGR. Disagreement on clinical significance.
Both evaluate claims C90-C93 about pregnancy parameters (litter size, resorptions, sex ratio). Both find these negative findings SUPPORTED. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C70-C72 about catch-up growth and nutrient transporter hypotheses. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting these are speculative. Peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN, implicitly questioning by noting mild phenotype. Agreement on speculative nature.
Both evaluate claims C25-C26 about gestational hypertension. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED, noting consistency with gestational hypertension. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C76-C77 (and C44, C75) about angiogenic factor regulation discrepancies. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN due to in vitro/in vivo discrepancy. Peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN, requesting protein-level analyses and primary cells. Agreement on need for stronger evidence.
Both evaluate claims C87-C88 (and C89) about Drp1 and MAL2 controls. Both find these SUPPORTED as appropriate mechanistic controls. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C66-C67, C86 about INF2-LCK mechanistic model. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by localization and invasion data. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED overall, though request additional mechanistic details. Substantial agreement.

Both evaluate claims C37-C38 about umbilical artery Doppler changes (EDV, PI). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED, noting consistency with poor placental perfusion and fetal distress. Complete agreement.
Both evaluate claim C89 about MAL2 trafficking control. Both find SUPPORTED as important specificity control. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C34-C35 about placental weights and fetal/placental ratio. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, explicitly requesting placental/fetal ratio to evaluate true placental insufficiency. Disagreement on completeness of characterization.

Both evaluate claim C27 about lack of proteinuria. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED, acknowledging potential strain dependence. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, explicitly requesting proteinuria and other PE features, noting model may only represent gestational hypertension. Disagreement on adequacy of PE model characterization.

Both evaluate claims C82-C83 about model limitations. OpenEval finds these acknowledgments SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning whether phenotype is severe enough. Partial agreement on limitations but disagreement on severity.

Both evaluate claims C57, C63 (and broader C56-C64) about major study conclusions. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by comprehensive data. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED but request strengthening with primary cells and protein analyses. Substantial agreement with caveats.
Both evaluate claim C24 about reduced spiral artery numbers. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED without critique. Complete agreement.

Both evaluate claims C80-C81 (and broader model claims C64-C67, C85-C86). OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED, accepting overall INF2-invasion-hypertension model. Substantial agreement.

Both evaluate claim C44 about in vitro angiogenic factor findings. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN due to in vitro/in vivo discrepancy. Peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN, requesting protein-level validation. Agreement on need for stronger evidence.

Both evaluate claim C84 about model limitations and differences from human PE. OpenEval finds acknowledgment SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting phenotype appears mild. Disagreement on severity assessment.

Both evaluate claim C74 about angiogenic factor regulation background. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by literature. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting protein-level validation of this mechanism. Disagreement on sufficiency of cited literature.

Both evaluate claim C68 about catch-up growth. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN as speculative hypothesis. Peer reviewers find SUPPORTED but question clinical relevance given normal birth weights. Partial disagreement on interpretation.

Both evaluate claim C69 about placental insufficiency. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN. Peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN, requesting placental/fetal ratio to confirm true placental insufficiency. Agreement on need for better characterization.
Both evaluate claim C33 about placental weight. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting placental/fetal ratio. Disagreement on completeness of data.

Both evaluate claim C65 about therapeutic potential. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN as speculative. Peer reviewers find SUPPORTED as part of overall model value. Disagreement on appropriateness of therapeutic speculation.

Both evaluate claim C75 about in vitro angiogenic factor regulation. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN due to in vitro/in vivo discrepancy. Peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN, requesting protein validation. Agreement on insufficient evidence.
Both evaluate claim C58 about reduced spiral arteries as major conclusion. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED. Complete agreement.
Both evaluate claim C56 about INF2 as novel placentation model. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting phenotype is relatively mild. Disagreement on model adequacy.

Both evaluate claim C49 about INF2 background functions. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by literature. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting investigation of additional INF2 functions. Disagreement on completeness.

Both evaluate claim C60 about catch-up growth as major conclusion. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN regarding severity. Partial disagreement.

Both evaluate claim C62 about placental vasculopathy as major conclusion. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED. Complete agreement.
Both evaluate claim C85 about LCK signaling background. OpenEval finds SUPPORTED by literature. Peer reviewers also find SUPPORTED as part of overall model. Complete agreement.
